entries.note: The proposition drops the repeated “I think” qualification. Being seen as “the WeWork of AI” supplies no shared criterion for fulfillment.

entries.test: Contemporaneous independent model evaluations and product comparisons would show whether Google and Anthropic had largely matched OpenAI and Chinese competitors were narrowing the gap.
entries.note: The context supports a plain reading about competitive AI capabilities.

entries.test: Public reporting and investor commentary before publication would show whether questioning of OpenAI's financing had increased.
Nvidia's public statements and contemporaneous reporting would establish whether it pulled back on a $100 billion OpenAI pledge in the week before publication.
entries.note: The proposition omits “last week.” The pullback is checkable; “a terrible signal” is an evaluative gloss.

entries.test: Publicly reported quarterly financial results and OpenAI's contemporaneous financial projections would establish recurring losses and its projected timetable to profitability.
entries.note: The profitability clause reports what OpenAI's existing projections show.
“I doubt” expresses uncertainty rather than a firm one-year prediction. The venture-capital condition is contextual, not explicit in this sentence.

entries.test: If OpenAI's venture funding dries up, public evidence of business failure and employee departures to competitors would test the predicted consequences.
entries.note: In this financial context, “toast” has a plain reading of business failure. No deadline is stated.

entries.test: Public investor statements and reporting on delayed, reduced, or abandoned investments would show whether Nvidia's retreat and the prospect of SoftBank following caused other investors to hesitate.
entries.note: The predicted investor response is firm; the possibility language concerns SoftBank's action.
“It’s looking more and more like” presents bailout dependence as an increasingly likely prospect.
The central commitment is that the government should refuse a bailout. The comparison with competitors is supporting factual material.

entries.test: Contemporaneous comparative AI evaluations and reporting on investor commitments would show whether OpenAI's competitive advantage and financing position were deteriorating.
entries.note: “Looks” qualifies an assessment of present financing rather than stating a probabilistic future outcome.
